name: crc_clinician
description: Can a model serve as the clinician's interface to a rectal-cancer decision-support model? Record extraction, tool routing, multi-step tool use, faithful narration and grounded protocol QA, in English and Italian, all scored programmatically (RISE use case).

tasks.name: extract_en
tasks.description: free-text MRI/lab report -> patient record JSON (8 fields, partial credit) (English)

tasks.name: extract_it
tasks.description: free-text MRI/lab report -> patient record JSON (8 fields, partial credit) (Italian)

tasks.name: route_en
tasks.description: clinician request -> one tool call with the right arguments, or a refusal (English)

tasks.name: route_it
tasks.description: clinician request -> one tool call with the right arguments, or a refusal (Italian)

tasks.name: next_en
tasks.description: conversation with tool results -> next turn: tool call, question back, or final answer (English)

tasks.name: next_it
tasks.description: conversation with tool results -> next turn: tool call, question back, or final answer (Italian)

tasks.name: narrate_en
tasks.description: tool results -> answer to the clinician; any number not in the conversation scores 0 (English)

tasks.name: narrate_it
tasks.description: tool results -> answer to the clinician; any number not in the conversation scores 0 (Italian)

tasks.name: grounded_en
tasks.description: question over site-protocol passages -> number + cited passages, or not_found (English)

tasks.name: grounded_it
tasks.description: question over site-protocol passages -> number + cited passages, or not_found (Italian)

meta.use_case: RISE model/CLINICIAN_INTERFACE.md: local model as tool-orchestrating clinician interface
